name: @devup-ui/plugin-utils
description: Shared utilities for Devup UI build plugins
author: devfive

scripts.test:types: bun ../../node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --moduleResolution bundler --module esnext --target esnext --types bun src/__tests__/shorthands.test.ts src/__tests__/compiler-types.test.ts src/__tests__/compiler.test.ts src/__tests__/native-platform.test.ts
scripts.build: bun run test:types && bun ../../node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc && bun build --target node src/index.ts --production --env=disable --outfile dist/index.cjs --format cjs --packages external --define import.meta.url=module.filename && bun build --target node src/index.ts --production --env=disable --outfile dist/index.mjs --format esm --packages external
